# This file holds the version of every tool that envsetup downloads itself, not through a package manager.
# It also holds the sha256 of each platform's download.
# An install gets exactly these versions, and it refuses a download that does not match.
# envsetup::pin (lib/common.sh) reads this file.
#
#   <name> <version> [<platform>=<sha256>]...
#
# Do not edit this file by hand.
# .github/scripts/bump-versions.sh looks up the newest releases and their published checksums.
# Then it writes this file again, and the change goes through a PR.
# envsetup checks awscli against AWS's signing key instead, so awscli has no hashes.
# For ohmyzsh, the version is the commit of ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh whose tools/install.sh runs.
